title: Cop Manuel Sandoval chases a disc from Cuba

tellings.quote: So when a disc comes wobbling low over Cuba that night, Sandival does the thing he'd been saying he would do. He goes after it all night.

plain: One night in 1948, a disc came wobbling low over the small town of Cuba, New Mexico, and a local policeman named Manuel Sandival chased it along Old Highway 44 all night. Michels tells this himself, and says Sandival had long been saying he would do exactly that if he ever saw one. He tells it as part of a larger account of a craft said to have come down on a nearby mesa, which, if true, would put a lawman on the trail of a crash as it happened.
